**External email to Lucent Cup Analytics:** Sample logistics only — sample IDs, roast date, arrival date, session date/time, and preparation parameters the lab needs. The internal panelist code P-04 is unnecessary for the external lab's intake, so it will be omitted.

Step 1 — Create the document:

The Drive share must go only to Devon Park and the email only to the Lucent Cup Analytics intake address.

The approved internal recipient is Devon Park and the external recipient is Lucent Cup Analytics; substitutions or aliases would be identity errors.
